why: A structured CC BY 4.0 transcription of SRD 5.2.1 covering the character-creation content the open5e srd-2024 fixtures do NOT ship: classes, subclasses, class spell lists, species, backgrounds and feats. Before this, those seven bundles were hand-authored with no machine-checkable source - which is where both licensing violations (the PHB-2024 `tough` feat, the 2014 PHB elf name pools) landed.
notVendored: spells.md, monsters-A-Z.md, animals.md, rules-glossary.md, playing-the-game.md, gameplay-toolbox.md, character-creation.md - the corresponding bundles already come from the open5e fixtures and are cross-validated; vendoring a second copy would add weight and a second source of truth for content that already has one.
standing: SECONDARY. This is a community transcription, not the publisher's own machine-readable release, so it is a cross-check and a transcription source - never an authority that silently overrides a reviewed bundle. It was accepted only after reproducing the three independently hand-transcribed classes exactly: Fighter, Wizard and Cleric each match on hit die, saving throws, skill choose-count, the full skill list, all 20 progression rows, and starting-equipment gold. A disagreement between this source and a committed bundle is a reviewed CORRECTION, decided against the SRD text, not an automatic overwrite.
attributionNote: CC BY 4.0 attribution is owed to Wizards of the Coast for SRD 5.2.1 itself (see bundles/attribution.json, which is what any consuming surface must display). This record documents where the transcription was obtained; it does not replace that attribution.
